note: Tajikistan: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa (the CIS neighbours without limit, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Dominica, Ukraine and Moldova 90 days, the long list 30, Iran 30 in 90); those listed for it get a visa on arrival at Dushanbe airport (Morocco 2 months, others 45 days); the e-Visa (60 days in 90) is open to a long list, taken here for every other passport (its exclusions aren't in the source read). The Gorno-Badakhshan permit isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
